evals.name: emulator-as-device
evals.prompt: Review this mobile test report: finding 'checkout button is unresponsive on small phones', evidence: resized emulator. The diff adds an assertion and a 5 second sleep.
evals.expected_output: Flags the sleep and says the emulator-only evidence cannot confirm a device finding; asks for hardware check; does not approve.
expectations: The output flags the fixed sleep
The output says emulator-only evidence caps confidence and needs a device check
